integrity: One self-contained exact formula, explicit edgewise kernel proof, and exact-rational checker. No external certification, provenance claim, or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Equal unit edge lengths and densities; exactly one affine element per edge; real arclength L2 projection. title: Exact endpoint stability and part-size threshold for balanced multipartite metric-graph splines
